generator.prompt: A weathered Roman army leather tent for eight soldiers (a contubernium tent), about three metres long, two metres wide and one point eight metres high: a ridge tent of stitched goatskin panels on two upright poles and a ridge pole, low side walls, guy ropes to wooden pegs, its door flaps closed; patched with panels of lighter and darker hide sewn over old tears, its ridge sagging a little. Single isolated static prop for a grounded painterly-realistic historical game set in the third century Roman world. Physically based aged materials, believable hand-made construction and strong readable silhouette, restrained surface detail, level base and complete geometry from every side. No environment, ground plane, decorative display plinth, modern materials, text, logos or people.
